gui.entitycontrol.components.title: Edit item components
gui.entitycontrol.breakspawn.equipment.h: §bItem selection and components editing directly use the selectors and editors supplied by KineticCore.
gui.entitycontrol.breakspawn.ui.equipmen: Left: the item (click to pick, edit components or clear). Right: drop chance on death (percent).
Click to pick an item, edit its components or clear the slot.
Choose from the item selector; the item's own components is kept.
Edit the components of this item.

One item per slot: click the item button to pick an item, edit its components or clear it; the number on the right is the drop chance on death. Changes go straight into the editor draft and take effect after Save on the main page.
